description:
Managing the transformation, delivery and exchange of data between both internal and external business systems across all business units using Informatica. 
 Gather business requirements for each interface from functional teams and business analyst. Build or update documentation to ensure standard procedures and knowledge transfer.
 Troubleshoot issues. 
 Development of interfaces, script routines and other configuration and customization of the system per business requirements 
 Maintain communication with management and customers regarding status of the system
 Basic/Required:  
 Legally authorized to work in the United States Bachelor's degree in MIS or Computer Science or other IT related 
 3+ years of experience developing with Informatica. 
 Experience developing with SQL & UNIX.
